activity.notes: Grothendieck joined the Institut des Hautes Études Scientifiques in 1959 and worked there through his resignation in 1970, transforming algebraic geometry with schemes, topos theory and cohomological methods. This is a historically bounded representative scholarly activity at the French research institute, not his whole mathematical career.
